title: WebChoreArena: Evaluating Web Browsing Agents on Realistic Tedious Web Tasks
authors_zh: Atsuyuki Miyai、Zaiying Zhao、Kazuki Egashira、Atsuki Sato、Tatsumi Sunada、Shota Onohara、Hiromasa Yamanishi、Mashiro Toyooka、Kunato Nishina、Ryoma Maeda、Kiyoharu Aizawa、Toshihiko Yamasaki
paper_type_zh: 长程网页智能体任务与终端评测基准
best_for_zh: 研究网页智能体评测、长程记忆与计算任务、终端 verifier、环境重放和轨迹发布边界的读者
one_line: WebChoreArena releases 532 author-curated WebArena tasks with answer-, URL-, and DOM-based terminal evaluators, but not paper-run trajectories or a fully pinned environment snapshot.
WebChoreArena 发布 532 个作者策划的 WebArena 任务及答案、URL、DOM 终端评测器，但未发布论文实验的完整轨迹、结果包或完全固定的环境镜像。
why: It turns memory-heavy browser chores into reusable task/evaluator records whose feedback can be inspected at the terminal boundary, while making clear that an executable benchmark is not automatically a trajectory dataset or a training release.
inclusion_reason: WebChoreArena releases a concrete environment-facing task object and mixed terminal feedback contract for long, memory- and calculation-heavy browser episodes. Its value to the environment-and-agent-trajectory track is the inspectable task/evaluator boundary, while absent trajectories, paper-bound environment snapshots, and complete run accounting remain explicit audit limits.

title: Problem
问题
html:
WebChoreArena asks whether browser agents that perform ordinary navigation can also complete tedious tasks that require retaining many observations, calculating over collected values, or carrying information across pages. The paper first appeared as arXiv:2506.01952v1 on 2025-06-02 and is listed by the official COLM site as an accepted COLM 2026 paper. Its decision boundary is benchmark construction and evaluation: it does not introduce a post-training algorithm or claim that the benchmark tasks were used to train the evaluated agents.

The released object is 532 human-curated task configurations over self-hosted WebArena-compatible sites: 117 Shopping, 132 Shopping Admin, 91 Reddit, 127 GitLab, and 65 cross-site tasks. 10 annotators selected from the authors created 117 templates—25, 29, 20, 28, and 15 respectively—and expanded them to about 4.5 instances per template through more than 300 hours of refinement. A task row specifies its sites and start state, intent template and instantiated intent, required observation modality, task types, execution description, instantiation values, and terminal evaluator configuration.

This belongs in Environment and Agent Trajectory Data because every evaluation instance induces a state-action-observation episode whose success is decided against live simulated-site state. The release boundary is equally important: the repository exposes tasks, wrappers, evaluator code, and a 102-task analysis subset, but not the paper-run successful and failed trajectories, observations, full result bundles, or a fully pinned WebArena image. The supported reuse class is evaluation only; task release must not be represented as a public trajectory-training corpus.

WebChoreArena 追问：已经能完成普通导航的浏览器智能体，能否进一步处理需要保留大量观察、对收集值做计算，或跨网页持续携带信息的繁琐任务。论文于 2025-06-02 以 arXiv:2506.01952v1 首次发布，COLM 官方网站已将其列为 COLM 2026 接收论文。它的研究边界是基准构建与评测，并未提出后训练算法，也没有声称用这些基准任务训练被评测的智能体。

公开的数据对象是 532 条人工策划的任务配置，运行于与 WebArena 兼容的自托管站点：Shopping 117 条、Shopping Admin 132 条、Reddit 91 条、GitLab 127 条，以及跨站任务 65 条。10 位从论文作者中选出的标注者创建了 117 个模板，五类分别为 25、29、20、28 和 15 个，再扩展到平均每个模板约 4.5 个实例，整个精炼过程超过 300 小时。一条任务记录给出站点与起始状态、意图模板与实例化意图、所需观察模态、任务类型、执行说明、实例化变量和终端 evaluator 配置。

该工作属于“环境与智能体轨迹数据”，因为每个评测实例都会诱导一段 state-action-observation episode，其成功由模拟站点的运行时状态决定。同样重要的是发布边界：仓库公开任务、wrapper、evaluator 代码和 102 题分析子集，但未公开论文实验的成功与失败轨迹、观察序列、完整结果包或完全固定的 WebArena 镜像。因此有证据支持的复用类别仅为评测；不能把任务发布表述成公开的轨迹训练语料。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a controlled extension of WebArena that concentrates difficulty in four task types: 222 Long-Term Memory, 168 Massive Memory, 100 Calculation, and 42 Others tasks in the pinned 532-row release. Rather than merely lengthening navigation, the benchmark requires agents to aggregate page content, preserve constraints over many interactions, and sometimes combine information across sites. Each task also declares its required observation: 451 are marked any, 69 require text/accessibility-tree information, and 12 require screenshots.

Its feedback contract is mixed and terminal. Across the released configurations, 423 tasks invoke string_match, 42 invoke url_match, and 99 invoke program_html; a task can combine evaluators. String evaluation uses exact equality, required-substring inclusion, or GPT-4o fuzzy semantic matching. URL evaluation checks the final displayed URL. program_html locates designated elements in the final page and compares their contents or attributes with task references. EvaluatorComb multiplies component scores, so one failed component can collapse the final score.

The verifier can observe the submitted answer, final URL, and configured DOM evidence, but it does not label the correctness of each intermediate action or directly expose all hidden site state and side effects. Its supervision is therefore answer-level and full-episode terminal scoring, not step-level process supervision. Relative to WebArena, the concrete change is a new set of harder memory- and calculation-centered tasks, explicit observation requirements, clearer answer-format instructions, and repeated author cross-checks. The environment family and evaluator mechanisms are adapted rather than newly invented.

本文的核心贡献是对 WebArena 做受控扩展，并把难度集中到四类任务上：固定版本的 532 条记录中包含 222 条 Long-Term Memory、168 条 Massive Memory、100 条 Calculation 和 42 条 Others。基准并非只是延长导航路径，而是要求智能体汇总页面内容、在多轮交互中持续保留约束，有时还要跨站点组合信息。每条任务还声明所需观察模态：451 条标记为 any，69 条需要文本或 accessibility tree 信息，12 条需要截图。

它采用混合式终端反馈契约。公开配置中有 423 条任务调用 string_match、42 条调用 url_match、99 条调用 program_html；同一任务可以组合多个 evaluator。字符串评测使用精确相等、必须包含指定子串，或由 GPT-4o 判断语义等价的 fuzzy matching。URL 评测检查最终显示的 URL；program_html 定位最终页面中的指定元素，再把内容或属性与任务参考值比较。EvaluatorComb 将各分量分数相乘，因此任一分量失败都可能使最终得分归零。

该 verifier 能观察提交答案、最终 URL 和配置中指定的 DOM 证据，但不会给每个中间动作标注正确性，也不能直接看到全部隐藏站点状态和副作用。因此其监督是 answer-level 与 full-episode 的终端评分，而不是 step-level process supervision。相较 WebArena，真正的变化是新增更难的记忆与计算任务、显式观察需求、更清晰的答案格式指令，以及多轮作者交叉核验；环境体系与 evaluator 机制主要是沿用和适配，并非全新发明。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction starts from the 4 principal self-hosted WebArena sites. 3 author annotators are assigned to each site, with 1 annotator spanning all 4, yielding 10 annotators in total. They explore site content and functions, propose memory-intensive analytical chores, and create templates plus several instantiations for each variable. Early prototypes are executed with a Claude-based agent to expose overly easy designs and model limitations. Annotators are instructed to remove ambiguity in both instructions and evaluation criteria and to standardize output wording when exact matching is intended.

The authors then cross-check tasks with 3 annotators per site and iterate through inference, error analysis, and revision. The final 117 templates yield 532 instances: 117 Shopping, 132 Shopping Admin, 91 Reddit, 127 GitLab, and 65 cross-site. Map tasks are excluded because of insufficient functionality and loss of access to the WebArena team's internal server after April 2025. The paper gives aggregate construction counts, but not task-level authorship, prototype histories, rejected proposals, Claude trial outputs, or selection thresholds.

At evaluation time, BrowserGym or AgentOccam receives an instantiated intent and partial page observations, acts in the configured environment, maintains agent-specific history or memory, and stops with an answer or infeasibility report. BrowserGym offers 15 browser, tab, navigation, messaging, and infeasibility actions and permits multiple actions per step; AgentOccam offers 8 basic, navigation, note/stop, and branch/prune actions with 1 action per step. Both are capped at 50 steps. Experiments use GPT-4o-2024-05-13, claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219, and gemini-2.5-pro-preview-03-25, with scaffold-specific temperatures and token limits documented in Appendix C.

The final answer, URL, and/or page state is scored by string_match, url_match, and program_html. The repository instructs evaluators to preserve task order because later tasks may mutate state, reset after each website, run cross-site tasks after reset, and reset before rerunning failures. Reproduction should pin repository commit 542abc538fd9558362119714989166904d82f5f4, the 532-row JSON, upstream WebArena/BrowserGym/AgentOccam revisions, browser and database images, authentication state, API model snapshots, task order, and reset schedule. Only the repository commit and task JSON are currently fixed by this Card; the remaining runtime versions are unknown.

构建流程从四个主要的自托管 WebArena 站点开始。每个站点分配 3 位作者标注者，其中 1 位覆盖全部四站，合计 10 位标注者。他们探索站点内容与功能，提出强调记忆的分析型事务，并为各变量创建模板及多个实例。早期原型由 Claude-based agent 执行，用于发现过于简单的设计和模型能力边界。标注者还被要求同时消除指令与评测标准的歧义，并在需要 exact matching 时统一输出措辞。

随后，作者以每站 3 位标注者交叉核验任务，并反复执行 inference、error analysis 和 revision。最终 117 个模板生成 532 个实例：Shopping 117 条、Shopping Admin 132 条、Reddit 91 条、GitLab 127 条、跨站任务 65 条。Map 任务因功能不足以及 WebArena 团队内部服务器在 2025 年 4 月后无法访问而被排除。论文提供了汇总构建数量，但未公开逐任务作者、原型历史、被拒方案、Claude 试跑输出或筛选阈值。

评测时，BrowserGym 或 AgentOccam 接收实例化意图和部分页面观察，在配置环境中执行动作，维护各自的历史或记忆，并以答案或 infeasibility 报告结束。BrowserGym 提供 15 类浏览器、标签页、导航、消息和不可行性动作，单步可以发出多个动作；AgentOccam 提供 8 类基础、导航、note/stop 与 branch/prune 动作，每步仅执行一个动作。两者均设 50 步上限。实验使用 GPT-4o-2024-05-13、claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219 和 gemini-2.5-pro-preview-03-25，Appendix C 给出了不同 scaffold 的温度和 token 上限。

最终答案、URL 和/或页面状态由 string_match、url_match 与 program_html 评分。仓库要求保持任务顺序，因为后续任务可能改变环境状态；每个站点评测后要重置，再执行跨站任务，失败任务重跑前也要重置。复现时应固定仓库 commit 542abc538fd9558362119714989166904d82f5f4、532 条 JSON、上游 WebArena/BrowserGym/AgentOccam 版本、浏览器与数据库镜像、认证状态、API 模型快照、任务顺序和 reset 日程。本卡目前只固定了仓库 commit 与任务 JSON，其余运行时版本仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 1 reports a large gap between WebArena and WebChoreArena under the same two agent scaffolds. With AgentOccam, GPT-4o falls from 42.8% to 6.8%, Claude 3.7 Sonnet from 52.0% to 23.5%, and Gemini 2.5 Pro from 54.8% to 37.8%. With BrowserGym, the corresponding changes are 36.4% to 2.6%, 51.5% to 23.1%, and 59.2% to 44.9%. These are author-reported accuracies, not an independent reproduction; cross-benchmark deltas also combine changed tasks with possible environment and evaluator effects.

Table 2 evaluates one task from each of the 102 non-cross-site templates. Adding screenshots to accessibility trees leaves GPT-4o at 2.9%, reduces Claude from 24.5% to 11.8%, and reduces Gemini from 46.1% to 39.2%. Table 3 further separates tasks whose answer depends on text inaccessible from the screenshot. The evidence supports an observation-modality sensitivity finding, not a general claim that images always harm web agents.

Table 4 tests a calculator on 215 calculation-specific tasks. Accuracy changes from 3.7% to 2.8% for GPT-4o, 19.5% to 18.6% for Claude, and 40.0% to 42.8% for Gemini; the agents use the tool on 35, 59, and 41 tasks respectively, each below 28% of the subset. The paper concludes that merely providing the calculator is insufficient because agents often do not invoke it.

Section 6 and Appendix B document counting across pages, arithmetic over more than 15 numbers, forgotten constraints and output formats, lost page state, hallucinated products, early termination, and abandoned searches. These failures substantiate the benchmark's intended difficulty. They do not establish that every task is annotation-error-free, that the fuzzy judge is calibrated, or that the unreleased runs can be replayed exactly.

Table 1 报告：在相同的两种 agent scaffold 下，WebArena 与 WebChoreArena 之间存在显著差距。使用 AgentOccam 时，GPT-4o 从 42.8% 降到 6.8%，Claude 3.7 Sonnet 从 52.0% 降到 23.5%，Gemini 2.5 Pro 从 54.8% 降到 37.8%。使用 BrowserGym 时，相应变化为 36.4% 到 2.6%、51.5% 到 23.1%，以及 59.2% 到 44.9%。这些是作者报告的 accuracy，并非独立复现；跨基准差值还同时包含任务、环境和 evaluator 可能发生的变化。

Table 2 从 102 个非跨站模板中各取一道任务进行分析。把截图加入 accessibility tree 后，GPT-4o 仍为 2.9%，Claude 从 24.5% 降至 11.8%，Gemini 从 46.1% 降至 39.2%。Table 3 又单独分析答案依赖截图中不可见文本的任务。证据支持“性能对观察模态敏感”，但不能推广为“图像总会损害网页智能体”。

Table 4 在 215 道 calculation-specific 任务上测试 calculator。GPT-4o 的 accuracy 从 3.7% 变为 2.8%，Claude 从 19.5% 变为 18.6%，Gemini 从 40.0% 变为 42.8%；三者分别在 35、59 和 41 道任务中调用工具，均低于该子集的 28%。论文据此认为，仅提供 calculator 并不足够，因为智能体经常不会主动调用它。

Section 6 与 Appendix B 记录了跨页计数错误、对超过 15 个数做运算时出错、遗忘约束或输出格式、丢失页面状态、虚构不存在的商品、过早结束以及放弃复杂搜索等现象。这些失败支撑了基准的目标难度，但不能证明每条任务都没有标注错误、fuzzy judge 已充分校准，或未发布的实验运行可以被精确重放。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline is WebArena, which supplies the self-hosted websites, task representation, and evaluator family. The authors re-examine 229 of 684 non-map WebArena tasks failed by all three BrowserGym agents and report that 134/229 (58.5%, or 20.0% of all 684) contain annotation errors or evaluation issues: 75 annotation errors and 59 evaluation issues. This audit motivates clearer instructions and evaluators as agent capability rises, but it is an analysis of WebArena rather than proof that WebChoreArena has zero defects.

WebChoreArena changes the task distribution and authoring target. It adds 532 newly curated chores centered on massive memory, calculation, and long-term memory; declares text/image requirements; standardizes answer formats where exact matching is used; and repeatedly tests and cross-checks tasks. The 65 cross-site tasks and 50-step execution budget make retained state and constraint tracking first-class evaluation variables rather than incidental navigation burden.

The work does not introduce the underlying websites, BrowserGym, AgentOccam, exact/must-include matching, URL checks, DOM inspection, or GPT-based fuzzy judgment. It also does not contribute a training objective, selected demonstration set, or released policy-rollout corpus. Its direction signal for reasoning-data research is therefore a more explicit environment task and terminal-feedback interface, not a new post-training recipe.

Before reuse, an evaluator should verify the fixed task JSON, reconcile the README schema with the actual records, pin the upstream environment and model APIs, inspect alternative-valid-answer behavior, preserve task order and reset semantics, and retain crashes and failed episodes. Without those checks, improved scores may reflect version drift, retries, or verifier behavior rather than stronger long-horizon reasoning.

最接近的基线是 WebArena，它提供自托管网站、任务表示和 evaluator 家族。作者重新检查了 684 道非 Map WebArena 任务中被三个 BrowserGym 智能体全部做错的 229 道，并报告其中 134/229（58.5%，相当于全部 684 道的 20.0%）含有标注错误或评测问题，具体为 75 个 annotation error 和 59 个 evaluation issue。随着智能体能力上升，这一审计支持使用更清晰的指令与 evaluator；但它分析的是 WebArena，不能证明 WebChoreArena 完全没有缺陷。

WebChoreArena 改变了任务分布和出题目标。它新增 532 道围绕 massive memory、calculation 与 long-term memory 人工策划的事务，声明文本或图像观察需求，在使用 exact matching 时统一答案格式，并通过多轮试跑与交叉核验精炼任务。65 道跨站任务和 50 步执行预算把状态保持与约束跟踪变成一等评测变量，而不只是导航负担的副产品。

该工作没有发明底层网站、BrowserGym、AgentOccam、exact/must-include matching、URL 检查、DOM 检查或基于 GPT 的 fuzzy judgment，也没有贡献训练目标、筛选后的 demonstration 集或公开的 policy rollout 语料。因此它对 reasoning-data 研究的方向价值在于更明确的环境任务与终端反馈接口，而不是新的后训练 recipe。

复用前，评测者应核对固定版本任务 JSON，协调 README schema 与实际记录的差异，固定上游环境和模型 API，检查 alternative-valid-answer 行为，保持任务顺序与 reset 语义，并保留 crash 和失败 episode。若缺少这些检查，分数上升可能来自版本漂移、重试或 verifier 行为，而非更强的长程推理。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors identify two primary limitations: the paper constructs a benchmark rather than developing a new agent method, and self-hosted simulated websites retain a gap from the live web. The simulation improves control but cannot capture all redesigns, access restrictions, personalization, or open-web side effects. An online extension is left as future work.

The feedback contract has concrete failure surfaces. Exact matching can reject a correct answer with harmless formatting; must-include checks can accept a required phrase without proving the whole response; GPT-4o fuzzy matching can drift or misjudge semantic equivalence; URL and DOM checks see only configured terminal evidence. Multiplying components makes one false negative decisive and does not identify the first erroneous action. No frozen judge outputs, calibration set, adversarial tests, or alternative-valid-answer audit is released.

Replayability remains partial. The paper fixes a 50-step cap, and the repository documents task-order and reset guidance, but the paper-bound WebArena commit, database hashes, browser image, authentication state, dependency lock, API snapshots, and complete reset manifest are unknown. The README describes affect_environment, required_wait, and a misspelled strage_state, while the pinned 532-row JSON exposes storage_state and omits the first two fields. Curator inference: this mismatch weakens automatic auditing of state mutation and waiting requirements.

Release and data-governance limits also matter. There is no train/dev/test split, hidden holdout, contamination audit, complete item-level construction lineage, or full successful/failed/crashed run release. The top-level repository and Kaggle dataset are Apache-2.0, but rights for adopted upstream code, seeded website content, screenshots, authentication state, and future trajectories require separate review. Consequently, the benchmark is usable for evaluation under pinned conditions, but the evidence does not justify training reuse or deterministic episode replay.

作者明确提出两项主要限制：论文侧重构建基准，而非开发新的智能体方法；自托管模拟网站与真实在线网页仍有差距。模拟环境提高了可控性，却无法覆盖所有页面改版、访问限制、个性化或开放网页副作用。在线版本被留作未来工作。

反馈契约存在具体失效面。Exact matching 可能因无害格式差异拒绝正确答案；must-include 可能只因出现指定短语就接受答案，却不能证明整体正确；GPT-4o fuzzy matching 可能随版本漂移或误判语义等价；URL 和 DOM 检查只能观察配置指定的终端证据。多个分量相乘会让一个 false negative 决定整题得分，也无法定位第一个错误动作。发布物中没有冻结的 judge 输出、校准集、对抗测试或 alternative-valid-answer 审计。

重放能力仍不完整。论文固定了 50 步上限，仓库也说明了任务顺序和 reset 方法，但论文实验对应的 WebArena commit、数据库 hash、浏览器镜像、认证状态、依赖锁、API 快照及完整 reset manifest 均为 unknown。README 描述了 affect_environment、required_wait 和拼写错误的 strage_state，而固定版本的 532 条 JSON 使用 storage_state，且没有前两个字段。Curator inference：这种不一致削弱了对状态变更和等待需求的自动审计能力。

发布与数据治理边界同样重要。该工作没有 train/dev/test split、隐藏 holdout、污染审计、完整逐条构建 lineage，也没有公开全部成功、失败和 crash 运行。顶层仓库与 Kaggle 数据集采用 Apache-2.0，但所采用的上游代码、预置网站内容、截图、认证状态和未来轨迹的权利仍需单独核验。因此该基准可在固定条件下用于评测，但现有证据不足以支持训练复用或确定性 episode 重放。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For evaluation, WebChoreArena is directly reusable as a harder companion to WebArena. Researchers can stratify the 532 tasks by site, long-term/massive-memory/calculation type, required observation modality, and evaluator type, then compare agent memory, planning, and tool-use mechanisms under the same 50-step budget. The 102-task subset supports cheaper modality or ablation studies, but it excludes cross-site templates and should not be reported as the full benchmark.

For verifier research, the release is a concrete mixed-contract case study. Exact, inclusion, fuzzy-judge, URL, and DOM checks can be compared for false positives, false negatives, version sensitivity, and alternative valid completions. A useful extension would retain component-level scores and first-error evidence rather than only their product, while pinning the GPT-4o judge and publishing calibration examples.

For reasoning-data audits, the Card supplies a checklist: distinguish task specifications from runtime trajectories; record environment, browser, database, model API, authentication and reset versions; preserve task order; count crashes and retries as explicit outcomes; release both successes and failures; and document benchmark exposure and rights. These checks are transferable to browser-agent RL and SFT pipelines even though this paper itself does not train agents.

Reuse class: safe for evaluation after pinning the released JSON, code commit, upstream environment, and reset protocol. It is not established as safe for training reuse because no training split, contamination policy, trajectory corpus, rollout lineage, or complete rights manifest is provided. Readers seeking trainable web-agent trajectories should treat WebChoreArena as an evaluation surface and construction reference, not as a substitute for a trajectory release.

在评测场景中，WebChoreArena 可以直接作为 WebArena 的高难度配套基准。研究者可按站点、long-term/massive-memory/calculation 类型、所需观察模态和 evaluator 类型对 532 道任务分层，再在相同 50 步预算下比较智能体的记忆、规划和工具使用机制。102 题子集适合成本较低的模态或消融研究，但它不含跨站模板，不能作为完整基准报告。

对于 verifier 研究，这一发布是具体的混合反馈契约案例。可以比较 exact、inclusion、fuzzy judge、URL 和 DOM 检查的 false positive、false negative、版本敏感性及 alternative valid completion。一个有价值的扩展是保留各 evaluator 分量得分和 first-error 证据，而不只给出乘积，同时固定 GPT-4o judge 并公开校准样例。

对于 reasoning-data 审计，本卡给出一份可执行清单：区分任务规格与运行时轨迹；记录环境、浏览器、数据库、模型 API、认证和 reset 版本；保持任务顺序；把 crash 与重试作为显式结果计数；同时发布成功和失败样本；并说明 benchmark exposure 与权利状态。尽管本文没有训练智能体，这些检查仍可迁移到 browser-agent RL 和 SFT pipeline。

复用等级：在固定公开 JSON、代码 commit、上游环境和 reset protocol 后，可安全用于评测。现有证据不足以确认其可安全用于训练，因为没有训练 split、污染政策、轨迹语料、rollout lineage 或完整权利清单。寻找可训练网页智能体轨迹的读者应把 WebChoreArena 视为 evaluation surface 与构建参考，而不是轨迹发布的替代品。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.4–3.5 first: 10 author annotators spend more than 300 hours turning 117 templates into 532 tasks, then attach string, URL, and DOM terminal evaluators.
  • Keep the object boundary explicit: the repository releases task configurations and evaluator code, not complete successful/failed trajectories, paper-run results, or a frozen environment image.
  • Use Appendix C when comparing scores: both scaffolds have a 50-step cap, but their action spaces, multiple-action policy, temperatures, token budgets, and memory mechanisms differ.
  • Treat Table 1 as author-reported benchmark evidence; Table 2 shows modality sensitivity on a 102-task non-cross-site subset, and Table 4 shows that merely exposing a calculator rarely induces tool use.
  • Before reproduction, pin commit 542abc538fd9558362119714989166904d82f5f4, reconcile README/JSON schema differences, preserve task order and resets, and audit judge drift, retries, contamination, and rights.

• 优先阅读 Sections 3.4–3.5：10 位作者标注者投入超过 300 小时，把 117 个模板扩展为 532 道任务，再配置字符串、URL 与 DOM 终端 evaluator。
  • 始终明确对象边界：仓库发布任务配置和 evaluator 代码，而不是完整成功/失败轨迹、论文实验结果或冻结的环境镜像。
  • 比较分数时查看 Appendix C：两种 scaffold 均设 50 步上限，但动作空间、单步多动作策略、温度、token 预算和记忆机制不同。
  • 把 Table 1 视为作者报告的基准证据；Table 2 在 102 道非跨站子集上揭示模态敏感性，Table 4 则表明仅提供 calculator 很少能促使智能体使用工具。
  • 复现前固定 commit 542abc538fd9558362119714989166904d82f5f4，协调 README 与 JSON schema 的差异，保持任务顺序和 reset，并审计 judge 漂移、重试、污染与权利。

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: Exact and must-include string checks can reject semantically correct answers because of formatting or accept answers containing a required substring without establishing full correctness.
GPT-4o fuzzy matching introduces model-version, prompt, and judge error; no frozen judge-response bundle, calibration set, or adversarial robustness audit is released.
URL and DOM-element checks observe only configured final-page evidence and can miss hidden state, unintended side effects, or alternative valid completions.
Multiplication across evaluator components can make one false negative collapse the whole task score and does not expose which intermediate agent step failed.
Task-order dependence, authenticated state, and incomplete reset/version manifests can change outcomes even in nominally self-hosted environments.

The README documents affect_environment, required_wait, and misspelled strage_state columns, while the pinned 532-row JSON instead exposes storage_state and omits the first two fields, weakening machine-readable replay and mutation auditing.
精确与必须包含字符串检查可能因格式拒绝语义正确的答案，或接受含所需子串但未确立完全正确性的答案。
GPT-4o 模糊匹配引入模型版本、提示与评审误差；未发布冻结的评审响应包、校准集或对抗稳健性审计。

Visual inputs can reduce accuracy relative to accessibility-tree-only inputs for some models and tasks.

Simulated sites preserve reproducibility better than the live web but leave a reality gap.
